comment: Skill manifest consumed by both the bid-time UI (auto-detect from MIME/extension) and the keeper at resolution time. The keeper uploads evidence files into the Anthropic Files API and references them in the system prompt; if a file's MIME or extension matches a skill's triggers, the corresponding `instructions` block is injected as additional system context for that file.

skills.name: Document Analysis
skills.description: Extract claims, dates, signatories, and verifiable facts from PDFs and Office documents.

skills.name: Video Analysis
skills.description: Decode video frames and timestamps; identify on-screen text, speakers, and scene transitions.
